newsitem.title: UK: Racal shares climb as Laing says "buy".
newsitem.headline: Racal shares climb as Laing says "buy".

text.p: Shares in Racal Electronics advanced on Tuesday as analysts at Credit Lyonnais Laing turned positive on the stock.
The shares were up 4p at 249p by 0932 GMT.
Engineering analyst Mike Styles said he had moved the stock to a "buy" from a "hold".
"We've pointed out that the share price has come back to the buying level again," he said. "We've seen a number of revivals elsewhere in the sector, especially among the smaller companies."
Since reaching a peak of 346p back in April last year, Racal's share price has shed 28 percent. It has underperformed the rest of the sector by as much as 20 percent since August.
"There are a lot of things going to go Racal's way in the longer term on datacoms, networks and radio, etc," Styles said.
"It looks to be the wrong price at the moment and we should start to see a rally in the share price."
